Create a basic response using the Responses API

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.createResponseRequestFromJson("{\"input\":\"Explain quantum computing in one sentence.\",\"model\":\"gpt-4o\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.createResponse(req: _req)
debugPrint(result.id())
debugPrint(result.status())
debugPrint(result.output())
```
